name: External Auditor
responsibilities: Plan and execute audit procedures on a client's financial statements: test transactions, confirm balances, and trace them back to source documents
Inspect account books and internal controls for weaknesses (duplicated effort, non-compliance, outright fraud) and write up findings management has to act on
Confer with client finance staff to resolve discrepancies before signing off on an opinion, and brief engagement seniors on scope and risk areas
skills: Reading a full set of financial statements and knowing which line items are audit risk (revenue recognition, inventory, related-party transactions)
Running accounting and audit software (workpapers, sampling, analytics) instead of just Excel by hand
Documenting evidence and conclusions so a reviewer two levels up can follow your logic without asking you
Explaining a finding to a client controller in plain terms without sounding accusatory
rawSkillPool: Business intelligence and data analysis software

evidence.quote: Examine, analyze, and interpret accounting records to prepare financial statements, give advice, or audit and evaluate statements prepared by others.

Prepare detailed reports on audit findings. Collect and analyze data to detect deficient controls, duplicated effort, extravagance, fraud, or non-compliance with laws, regulations, and management policies.
